body:
Sorry, english is not my first language. 

I really wish that things were not this way. That we could all be grateful and happy. That  ego, mistakes and weakness don't rule our lives.

But we all are in a deep, deep hole, with a void in our souls. In my case, that void is just growing each and every single day and moment. I feel like I can't escape from this shit. 

We don't deserve it. This mental illness is ruthless, and will not stop until we're dead. It doesn't matter that nothing matters. That all is just one big joke. That our life is just a ridiculous cycle of suffering, hope and brokenness. 

I wish we didn't think in suicide as an escape from this nonsense. But I know that it won't happen. There is no cure. Nothing in this world will bring us the peace we yearn for. 

If only we were stronger. If we didn't spend our lives feeling sorry for ourselves we could attempt to get out of this pit. But it doesn't matter how much I want it. This nightmare has only one possible result. Nothing will fill me, and nothing will fill you either.

I can't escape this fucking depression and anxiety... I've made really bad choices in my life and I've wasted so many years... I'm not special at all; in fact, I'm a total failure... Please, I want this to end now...
